Name: Implement Five9 Member Callback for PN Inbound Queues
Description: User StoryAs a Pharmacy Navigator member calling the BA or CA inbound line,I want the option to receive a callback instead of waiting in queue,so that I can avoid long hold times while still retaining my place in line and speaking with an advocate as soon as one becomes available.Business ValueReduce member wait times and improve call experience.Support queue management during periods of high call volume.Help maintain service levels and target queue wait times below 30 seconds.Improve member satisfaction by eliminating the need to remain on hold.Acceptance CriteriaScenario 1: Callback Option OfferedGiven a member calls the BA or CA inbound line and enters a queueWhen the member has been waiting for 10 secondsThen the system shall play a callback offer message:""If you would like a callback when a member advocate is available, press X.""And the final script and DTMF selection shall be confirmed with Five9.Scenario 2: Repeat Callback OfferGiven a member remains in queue after declining or ignoring the callback optionWhen 60 additional seconds have elapsedThen the callback offer message shall be replayedAnd continue repeating every 60 seconds while the member remains in queue.Scenario 3: Member Requests CallbackGiven a member selects the callback optionWhen the request is accepted by Five9Then the member's place in queue shall be maintainedAnd the callback request shall be associated with the same skill queue the member originally called.Scenario 4: Callback ConnectionGiven an advocate becomes available for the queued callbackWhen Five9 initiates the callbackThen the callback shall be delivered to an advocate before the member is dialedAnd the member shall be connected directly to a live advocate when answeringAnd the member shall not experience additional queue wait time after answering.Scenario 5: Callback PrioritizationGiven callback requests and outbound campaign calls are both waitingWhen an advocate becomes availableThen callback requests shall be prioritized ahead of outbound campaign callsAnd regular inbound calls shall continue to take priority over callback requests.Scenario 6: Voicemail HandlingGiven a callback attempt reaches voicemailWhen the member does not answerThen the advocate shall have the ability to leave a voicemail message.Scenario 7: Reporting and AnalyticsGiven callback activity occurs within Five9When operational reports are generatedThen callback data shall be available for reporting and trend analysis. Minimum reporting requirements include:Number of callback requests by dayTime between callback request and callback attemptNumber of successful live connectionsNumber of callbacks resulting in voicemailCallback completion rateNotes / Solution DesignUtilize the standard Out-of-the-Box Five9 Callback solution.Callbacks maintain their position in queue.Members are not required to re-enter the queue once called back.Solution does not rely on Estimated Wait Time (EWT) calculations.Agent productivity impact should be considered, as advocates hear the outbound dialing and ring time while waiting for the member to answer.Definition of DoneCallback functionality enabled for BA and CA inbound queues.Callback messaging configured and approved.Skill-based callback routing validated.Callback prioritization rules implemented.Voicemail workflow validated.Reporting requirements documented and available in operational reporting.UAT completed and approved by Business, Operations, and Product.Inbound routing is out of scope for this effort. This feature applies to warm transfers or direct inbound calls.
